shots.content: Inside a living room, a sofa and armchairs surround a low coffee table between a bookcase and the doorway. A woman in an orange shirt sits on the bookcase-side sofa seat and recounts the dance partners from the ball, a man in a white shirt sits on the doorway-side sofa seat, and a woman in a blue shirt sits on the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway side, looking across the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt asks the woman in an orange shirt to hear no more details about the dance partners.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two adjacent sofa seats.

shots.content: The woman in an orange shirt replies to the man in a white shirt that the newcomer danced with everyone of note during the evening.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the bookcase side, looking across the coffee table toward the doorway, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.
